		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_SYR_arab_world_programme_earned
		add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_SYR_arab_world_programme_supply_consumption_factor = -0.01 }
		add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_SYR_arab_world_programme_bureaucracy_cost_multiplier_modifier = 0.01 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SYR_arab_world_10_implemented
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SYR_arab_world_10_entry_reward_20261019 }
		}
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_SYR_arab_world_10_entry_reward_20261019
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_SYR_arab_world_programme_earned
		add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_SYR_arab_world_programme_production_speed_infrastructure_factor = 0.02 }
		add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_SYR_arab_world_programme_bureaucracy_cost_multiplier_modifier = 0.01 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SYR_arab_world_13_implemented
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SYR_arab_world_13_entry_reward_20261019 }
		}
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_SYR_arab_world_13_entry_reward_20261019
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_SYR_arab_world_programme_earned
		add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_SYR_arab_world_programme_political_power_factor = 0.005 }
		add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_SYR_arab_world_programme_bureaucracy_cost_multiplier_modifier = 0.005 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SYR_levant_entry_implemented
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SYR_levant_entry_entry_reward_20261019 }
		}
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_SYR_levant_entry_entry_reward_20261019
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_SYR_levant_programme_earned
		add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_SYR_levant_programme_army_defence_factor = 0.02 }
		add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_SYR_levant_programme_supply_consumption_factor = 0.01 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SYR_levant_10_implemented
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SYR_levant_10_entry_reward_20261019 }
		}
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_SYR_levant_10_entry_reward_20261019
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_SYR_levant_programme_earned
		add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_SYR_levant_programme_supply_consumption_factor = -0.01 }
		add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_SYR_levant_programme_army_personnel_cost_multiplier_modifier = 0.01 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SYR_levant_13_implemented
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SYR_levant_13_entry_reward_20261019 }
		}
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_SYR_levant_13_entry_reward_20261019
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_SYR_levant_programme_earned
		add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_SYR_levant_programme_army_org_factor = 0.01 }
		add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_SYR_levant_programme_army_personnel_cost_multiplier_modifier = 0.01 }
	}
}
COLDWAR_SYR_recompute_starting_spirits = {
	set_variable = { COLDWAR_SYR_divided_command_political_power_factor = -0.1 }
	set_variable = { COLDWAR_SYR_divided_command_army_org_factor = -0.05 }
	set_variable = { COLDWAR_SYR_emergency_state_stability_factor = 0.04 }
	set_variable = { COLDWAR_SYR_emergency_state_research_speed_factor = -0.04 }
	set_variable = { COLDWAR_SYR_emergency_state_political_power_factor = -0.05 }
	set_variable = { COLDWAR_SYR_legacy_1967_army_org_factor = -0.05 }
	set_variable = { COLDWAR_SYR_legacy_1967_war_support_factor = 0.05 }
	set_variable = { COLDWAR_SYR_uneven_services_research_speed_factor = -0.05 }
	set_variable = { COLDWAR_SYR_uneven_services_production_speed_buildings_factor = -0.05 }
	set_variable = { COLDWAR_SYR_state_sector_strain_bureaucracy_cost_multiplier_modifier = 0.08 }
	set_variable = { COLDWAR_SYR_state_sector_strain_agricolture_productivity_modifier = -0.05 }
	set_variable = { COLDWAR_SYR_rain_sensitive_farms_agricolture_productivity_modifier = -0.08 }
	set_variable = { COLDWAR_SYR_citizenship_exclusion_stability_factor = -0.04 }
	set_variable = { COLDWAR_SYR_citizenship_exclusion_political_power_factor = -0.03 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				AND = {
					has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SYR_dual_command_resolved
					has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SYR_opening_settlement_implemented
				}
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SYR_parliament_05_implemented
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SYR_military_transfer_agreed
			}
		}
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_SYR_divided_command_political_power_factor = 0 }
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_SYR_divided_command_army_org_factor = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SYR_emergency_abolished }
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_SYR_emergency_state_stability_factor = 0 }
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_SYR_emergency_state_research_speed_factor = 0 }
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_SYR_emergency_state_political_power_factor = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SYR_army_05_implemented }
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_SYR_legacy_1967_army_org_factor = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { controls_state = 587 }
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_SYR_legacy_1967_war_support_factor = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SYR_fiscal_09_implemented }
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_SYR_uneven_services_research_speed_factor = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SYR_infrastructure_12_implemented }
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_SYR_uneven_services_production_speed_buildings_factor = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SYR_agriculture_05_implemented }
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_SYR_state_sector_strain_agricolture_productivity_modifier = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SYR_industry_12_implemented }
		subtract_from_variable = {
			COLDWAR_SYR_state_sector_strain_bureaucracy_cost_multiplier_modifier = 0.04
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SYR_fiscal_12_implemented }
		subtract_from_variable = {
			COLDWAR_SYR_state_sector_strain_bureaucracy_cost_multiplier_modifier = 0.04
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SYR_agriculture_12_implemented }
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_SYR_rain_sensitive_farms_agricolture_productivity_modifier = -0.04 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SYR_agriculture_15_implemented }
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_SYR_rain_sensitive_farms_agricolture_productivity_modifier = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SYR_citizenship_03_implemented
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SYR_reopen_citizenship_review
			}
		}
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_SYR_citizenship_exclusion_stability_factor = -0.02 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SYR_citizenship_15_implemented }
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_SYR_citizenship_exclusion_stability_factor = 0 }
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_SYR_citizenship_exclusion_political_power_factor = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				NOT = {
					check_variable = { COLDWAR_SYR_divided_command_political_power_factor = 0 }
				}
				NOT = {
					check_variable = { COLDWAR_SYR_divided_command_army_org_factor = 0 }
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_dynamic_modifier = COLDWAR_SYR_divided_command }
			}
			add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_SYR_divided_command }
		}
	}
	else = {
		if = {
			limit = { has_dynamic_modifier = COLDWAR_SYR_divided_command }
			remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_SYR_divided_command }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				NOT = {
					check_variable = { COLDWAR_SYR_emergency_state_stability_factor = 0 }
				}
				NOT = {
					check_variable = { COLDWAR_SYR_emergency_state_research_speed_factor = 0 }
				}
				NOT = {
					check_variable = { COLDWAR_SYR_emergency_state_political_power_factor = 0 }
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_dynamic_modifier = COLDWAR_SYR_emergency_state }
			}
			add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_SYR_emergency_state }
		}
	}
	else = {
		if = {
			limit = { has_dynamic_modifier = COLDWAR_SYR_emergency_state }
			remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_SYR_emergency_state }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				NOT = {
					check_variable = { COLDWAR_SYR_legacy_1967_army_org_factor = 0 }
				}
				NOT = {
					check_variable = { COLDWAR_SYR_legacy_1967_war_support_factor = 0 }
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_dynamic_modifier = COLDWAR_SYR_legacy_1967 }
			}
			add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_SYR_legacy_1967 }
		}
	}
	else = {
		if = {
			limit = { has_dynamic_modifier = COLDWAR_SYR_legacy_1967 }
			remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_SYR_legacy_1967 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				NOT = {
					check_variable = { COLDWAR_SYR_uneven_services_research_speed_factor = 0 }
				}
				NOT = {
					check_variable = { COLDWAR_SYR_uneven_services_production_speed_buildings_factor = 0 }
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_dynamic_modifier = COLDWAR_SYR_uneven_services }
			}
			add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_SYR_uneven_services }
		}
	}
	else = {
		if = {
			limit = { has_dynamic_modifier = COLDWAR_SYR_uneven_services }
			remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_SYR_uneven_services }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				NOT = {
					check_variable = { COLDWAR_SYR_state_sector_strain_bureaucracy_cost_multiplier_modifier = 0 }
				}
				NOT = {
					check_variable = { COLDWAR_SYR_state_sector_strain_agricolture_productivity_modifier = 0 }
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_dynamic_modifier = COLDWAR_SYR_state_sector_strain }
			}
			add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_SYR_state_sector_strain }
		}
	}
	else = {
		if = {
			limit = { has_dynamic_modifier = COLDWAR_SYR_state_sector_strain }
			remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_SYR_state_sector_strain }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				NOT = {
					check_variable = { COLDWAR_SYR_rain_sensitive_farms_agricolture_productivity_modifier = 0 }
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_dynamic_modifier = COLDWAR_SYR_rain_sensitive_farms }
			}
			add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_SYR_rain_sensitive_farms }
		}
	}
	else = {
		if = {
			limit = { has_dynamic_modifier = COLDWAR_SYR_rain_sensitive_farms }
			remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_SYR_rain_sensitive_farms }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				NOT = {
					check_variable = { COLDWAR_SYR_citizenship_exclusion_stability_factor = 0 }
				}
				NOT = {
					check_variable = { COLDWAR_SYR_citizenship_exclusion_political_power_factor = 0 }
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_dynamic_modifier = COLDWAR_SYR_citizenship_exclusion }
			}
			add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_SYR_citizenship_exclusion }
		}
	}
	else = {
		if = {
			limit = { has_dynamic_modifier = COLDWAR_SYR_citizenship_exclusion }
			remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_SYR_citizenship_exclusion }
		}
	}
}
COLDWAR_SYR_initialize = {
	if = {
		limit = { original_tag = SYR IMP_is_1970_scenario = yes }
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SYR_initialized }
			}
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_SYR_initialized
			COLDWAR_SYR_initialize_programme_variables = yes
			COLDWAR_SYR_politics_init = yes
			COLDWAR_SYR_foreign_init = yes
		}
		COLDWAR_SYR_migrate_entry_rewards_20261019 = yes
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_focus_tree = COLDWAR_SYR_1970_focus }
			}
			load_focus_tree = COLDWAR_SYR_1970_focus
		}
		COLDWAR_SYR_refresh_programmes = yes
	}
}
COLDWAR_SYR_weekly = {
	if = {
		limit = { original_tag = SYR IMP_is_1970_scenario = yes }
		COLDWAR_SYR_initialize = yes
		COLDWAR_SYR_politics_weekly = yes
		COLDWAR_SYR_foreign_weekly = yes
		COLDWAR_SYR_refresh_programmes = yes
	}
}
